t: The republic was restored in 1867 when Benito Juárez defeated the French-backed empire of Maximilian of Habsburg.
The Revolution of 1910–1920 produced the Constitution of 1917, land reform and a ruling party that held power until 2000.
Since NAFTA in 1994 and the democratic transition of 2000, Mexico has become a large industrial economy tied to the United States.
dyk: The ruling party founded in 1929 changed its name twice, becoming the PRI in 1946, and won every presidential election for 71 years until Vicente Fox’s victory in 2000.
ev: Maximilian is executed at Querétaro and Benito Juárez restores the republic
Porfirio Díaz seizes power under the Plan of Tuxtepec
Francisco I. Madero’s call to revolt begins the Mexican Revolution
The Constitution of 1917 is promulgated at Querétaro
Plutarco Elías Calles founds the National Revolutionary Party
Lázaro Cárdenas expropriates foreign oil companies
NAFTA comes into force and the Zapatistas rise in Chiapas
Vicente Fox’s election ends seven decades of PRI rule

f.predecessor: Second Mexican Empire; Second Federal Republic of Mexico
